title: Art. 6.1 — Annex 6 Part I - Operation of Aircraft: International Commercial Air Transport - Aeroplanes, Chapter 6, Article 6.1 - General equipment requirements, 6.1
content:
6.1 General

6.1.1 In addition to the minimum equipment necessary for the issuance of a certificate of airworthiness, the instruments, equipment and flight documents prescribed in the following paragraphs of this chapter shall be installed or carried, as appropriate, in aeroplanes according to the type and area of operation.
